prompt: A teacher reports a mean of $70$ but a median of $85$. This suggests there are likely some ___?

choices.label: low outliers (a few very small values)
high outliers (a few very large values)

hint: Which type of outlier pulls the mean DOWN, away from the median?

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Mean is fair-shares; median is the middle. Pick the one the question actually asks for.
Which type of outlier pulls the mean DOWN, away from the median?
Low values pull the mean below the median.

explanation: Outliers pull the mean toward them but barely move the median.
Mean ($70$) is less than median ($85$) → some low outliers pulled it down.
